description.value:
You can craft a few rudimentary grenades each day. You gain the formulas for two common grenades. Each day during your daily preparations, you can create two temporary grenades of your level or lower from your formulas. Grenades prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft and don't have any sale value. They're temporary items and fall apart the next time you make your daily preparations.

If you're an expert in Crafting, you can create three grenades per day. If you're a master in Crafting, you can create four grenades per day. If you're legendary in Crafting, you can create six grenades per day.
